raw.query: SELECT split_part(run_id, '_', 3) AS model, MAX(CASE WHEN p99_ttft_ms < 1000 AND p99_itl_ms < 100 THEN CASE WHEN run_id LIKE '%_s%' THEN substring(run_id from '_s([0-9]+)$')::int ELSE 1 END END) AS strict_knee, MAX(CASE WHEN p99_ttft_ms < 2000 THEN CASE WHEN run_id LIKE '%_s%' THEN substring(run_id from '_s([0-9]+)$')::int ELSE 1 END END) AS lax_knee FROM provenance.llm_run_summary WHERE run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k%' GROUP BY 1;
raw.observed: aic: strict=2, lax=4 (1.00 octaves); poly: strict=3, lax=8 (1.42 octaves)
